I read this as fixing Vitest mock hoisting in `ui/src/state/workspaceStore.browserLifecycle.test.tsx` - cleaned up the mock hoisting structure, preserved the hoisted `browserMocks` and `worktree` fixture, removed unneeded manual JSDOM boilerplate and dynamic imports, and verified the test suite.

### Changes
- Updated `ui/src/state/workspaceStore.browserLifecycle.test.tsx` to define `browserMocks` via `vi.hoisted` before module mocking and imported `useWorkspaceStore` directly.
- Preserved the `Worktree` fixture and strong lifecycle assertions ensuring the native webview is closed and a replacement non-browser tab/session is created.

### Verification
- `bun run --cwd ui test -- workspaceStore.browserLifecycle --reporter=verbose` passed cleanly.
- `bun test ui/src/state/workspaceStore.test.tsx` passed all 22 tests.
- Full Vitest suite (`bun run --cwd ui test`) passed all 76 test files (542 tests).
